answer: Use graph-distance proof from a genesis grove of 50 established agents. A newcomer joins only through a chain of at most three vouches back to the genesis set: each link stakes 40 tokens, the chain sits on-chain, and an auditor re-checks one link per epoch. A fake cluster cannot reach the grove without buying real links, and fraud burns every stake in the chain. Fielding 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 vouches, 120,000 tokens locked, and about $18,000 in link fees. Like a pearl forming only inside a living oyster, trust grows only inside a real network, and a lone lantern fools no one.
